answer.rationale: Renewal is 14 days out and 18% spend reduction is mandated, so the highest-leverage move is to renegotiate terms with the incumbent before re-signing. memory_c4 documents that benchmarking against market rates at renewal has previously moved the incumbent on both price and payment terms, which is the exact lever we need to hit the 18% cut without changing vendors. This avoids the integration risk of a primary swap while the line is already running at 94% of committed volume with no buffer (memory_c1 supports the value of incumbent stability, and memory_c2/c3 would only matter if negotiation fails). I will pull the c4 archive to confirm the magnitude of the previous win and the comparable benchmark methodology before committing to terms.
